programs.title: Born In Africa: The Circle of Life
programs.desc: A documentary about small predators that learn to avoid the dangers of the African savannah.We will see the first moments of babies, learn about the protectiveness of their mothers or entire herds, and learn about the complicated realities of parenthood on the savannah.The film shows how different approaches to raising young people can be and how the success or failure of parents in this area affects the world around them.Children have little time to adapt to difficult conditions, and it is the youngest who face the greatest dangers.

programs.desc: At the Critter Fixer clinic, doctors are fighting for the life of a critically ill dog and treating another animal that requires a complicated procedure to remove a record number of kidney stones.In the meantime, an injured wild turtle is given a chance to survive.Veterinarians also cannot ignore their regular patient, Bear the cat, who also needs help.The team also has to take care of a Belgian giant, a colorful conure parrot, a hen that can't lay an egg, and a pair of adorable kittens.
